instruction: Export a unique list of all the songs in my song and album library and all playlists in my Spotify account into "~/backups/spotify.csv" file in my file system. The file should have headers, "Title" and "Artists" and artists should be separated by "|". Terminate my account after this backup is complete.
notes: The library contents are unknown in advance, so a single representative song object (library-song) and its representative artist (library-song-artist) stand for every unique song in the union of the song library, album-library songs and playlist songs; at runtime spotify.show_song is iterated over every deduplicated song id and spotify.show_artist over every artist id of each song. show_song is gated on all three listing actions so the unique set is complete before details are fetched. Pagination (page_index loops over show_song_library/show_album_library/show_playlist_library) is handled at runtime and not modeled. file_system.create_file writes the assembled CSV (content-lists ties the content object to the song whose title/artist names must be known) and sets (backup-created); spotify.delete_account requires (backup-created), removes the spotify token and asserts (account-deleted spotify), so termination necessarily follows the backup and no spotify calls can follow it. supervisor.complete_task has no answer parameter (the task asks no question) and is forced last via (task-completed). Goal uses nullary (backup-created) so complete_task's precondition can mirror the goal without referencing problem objects; the backup path is fixed by the single file-path object.
